chunks: ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah asked him about the time of the Dhuhr and ʿAsr prayers, and he said:
“When the sun declines, the time of Dhuhr and ʿAsr both enters together, except that this one is before that one. Then you remain within the time of both of them together until the sun sets.”

key_terms.الشَّمْسُ: the sun, whose movement determines the prayer time
key_terms.تَغِيبَ: sets or disappears below the horizon
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the prescribed time period for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When does the time for Dhuhr and ʿAsr begin and end in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the beginning of the shared time for the Dhuhr and ʿAsr prayers. It states that both times begin when the sun declines from its zenith, while clarifying that Dhuhr is to be performed before ʿAsr, and that their shared time continues until sunset.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.647 - Ubaid ibn Zurarah asked Him, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), about the timing of the Dhuhr (noon) and Asr (afternoon) prayers.
Imam (as) replied:

"When the sun declines (from its zenith), the time for both Dhuhr and Asr begins together, except that this (Dhuhr) is before that (Asr). Then you remain within the time for both of them until the sun sets”.
